title: Read-only subagents end without the lane commit requirement
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: a read-only general-purpose research subagent (Agent tool, routed to krn-lane by the Agent hook) was refused its end by the Stop gate twice ('no commit') and had to end on 'BLOCKER: read-only task'; its real report sat in an earlier message the lead never receives, so the report was lost twice.
Outcome: a subagent whose brief is read-only (no worktree, no task id, or the krn-reader/Explore/research types) ends without the commit requirement: the Stop gate exits 0 for a session with no edits and no lane claim, and the Agent routing hook leaves read-only briefs on a read-only type.
Why: lost research reports cost a full rerun and push leads to read files themselves, against KRN-13.
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop.test.ts: a session transcript with no Edit/Write and no claim ends with exit 0.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, the Agent routing hook
